ground.method: MoGe turf normals; ball-size camera-height anchors; reviewed contact constraints

review.source: Visual review of supplied over-fake tutorial; inclusive frame ranges. Kicks and subsequent possible bounces are excluded from rolling constraints.
review.notes: Grounded ranges include short foot occlusions bracketed by visible contact. Flight heights outside these ranges remain uncertain single-view estimates, with nonpenetration only. No gravity-based synthetic bounce is added.

ground.limits: Camera yaw and world translation are not recovered. Flight depth remains uncertain; nonpenetration only outside reviewed rolling ranges.

coordinates: ground-aligned pitch/roll, per-shot horizontal origin, estimated metric scale
smoothing: symmetric 3-frame [0.2, 0.6, 0.2], never across cuts or missing frames

ball.depth: shared ground/camera estimate; reviewed rolling contact; size-based flight estimate
